patterns: APPSC asks one-line facts: first geothermal project = Ladakh (Puga), 3G bioethanol = algal biomass, gobar gas = methane / biomass energy.
Classic recurring items across PSCs: Jatropha = biodiesel crop, gasohol = petrol + ethanol, molasses -> power alcohol, SpiceJet first biofuel flight (Aug 2018).
Generations trap: 3G = algae, 4G = genetically modified algae; ethanol crop = maize/sugarcane not jatropha/pongamia.
UPSC-style statement items on NPB feedstocks and SAF feedstock appear, but APPSC itself stays at direct recall.
App MCQs lean heavily on multi-statement policy detail (NBCC, PM JI-VAN, SATAT obligations, co-firing %) far beyond PYQ depth; few direct one-liners.
